title: Northbeam TechWorks Credit Control: Write-Offs Standing Against a Rebilled Figure
content:
The write-off the plan's cover carried is not set against the rebilled figure. Which of the write-offs standing on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job do come off the figure rebilled is read from the grounds they were granted on.

- Where a write-off granted on the plan's cover stands on the job, nothing comes off.
- Where write-offs granted as a goodwill gesture stand on the job and none granted on the plan's cover does, those goodwill write-offs come off.
- Where neither situation holds, the write-offs standing on the job come off.

## The grounds side by side

| Write-offs standing on the job | What comes off the figure rebilled |
| --- | --- |
| at least one on the plan's cover | nothing |
| some as a goodwill gesture, none on the plan's cover | those goodwill write-offs |
| some on other grounds only, none on the plan's cover and none as goodwill | the write-offs standing on the job |
| none at all | nothing, there being none to come off |

The first line governs whenever a write-off on the plan's cover stands on the job, whatever else stands beside it.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**Nothing written off at all.** Nothing comes off, there being no write-off standing on the job.

**A write-off on the retailer's own error alone.** A hypothetical job carries 31.20 USD written off on the retailer's own error, with none on the plan's cover and none as goodwill. The third reading governs and 31.20 USD comes off.

**Goodwill alone.** The job carries 28.00 USD granted as a goodwill gesture and nothing on the plan's cover. That 28.00 USD comes off the figure rebilled.

**A plan write-off standing.** The job carries 145.80 USD written off on the plan's cover alongside the 28.00 USD of goodwill. Nothing comes off the figure rebilled.
